Text: {sadA}You, uh, you stopped breathing, you know... {worrieda}when you passed out or... or died... I guess.
[quietly] {sadB}It... um... it kind of scared the Hell out of me.
Hey, you're not really gonna send me to The Farm, are ya?
Look, uh, maybe a few will get sent up, but you're my friend, Colin. I wouldn't do that to you.
I don't know...[beat] Snow will come around. She's just...
The Crane thing hit her hard, and... she doesn't really know who her friends are right now.
The rules are the rules. I don't get to make 'em, I just enforce 'em.
Bull. Shit.
[glum] After everything we fuckin' been through... you don't have the nerve to give me a straight answer.
{FearA}No!
{angrya}[determined] We're destroying the tree.
{Professional}This time was no joke. Eat as many metal shellings as you see fit, but take just one more silver round near your heart... and the only place I'll be visiting you is the morgue.
[sharp]Bigby, wait.
When you get the Crooked Man... make sure you bring him back alive. He has to stand trial.
I mean... Your eyes... and the teeth... you're not really supposed to do that are you?
Not if I can avoid it.
No...
[pickup2][somewhat shocked and sympathetic]You knew this girl?
{WorriedA}She was reported missing, but I... {SadB}I guess it just slipped through the cracks.
{FlusteredA}Holly's sister... {FearA}Lily.
[half-asleep]I just don't know what Bigby's doing, if he... if he cares about it, if he even gives a shit.
[angry] {AngryB}What monsters are you! What horrible, evil, villainous, warped {FearA}monsters are you?!
{angrya}We're not burning the tree, Snow.
{worrieda}That's why you can't tell me anything...
{angrya}It's the ribbon, isn't it?
[being shot] Urhg!
{EvilA}Oh, I see... come to audition your bitch.
Hey, you like my ribbon?
[panicked] Oh God, Bigby!
[half-asleep]Do you even give a shit about us?[beat] The strays?
[professional, not overly cordial]Why don't you have a seat, Sheriff? [pointed]We have a great deal to discuss.
